## Outline

- **(8m) What changes when it can see your session.** Posit Assistant reads the
  data frame rather than your description of it. Where that helps, and where it
  quietly misleads. Positron and RStudio both work for everything below.

  One naming note for the room: Posit Assistant replaced Positron Assistant and
  Databot as of Positron 2026.07, so tutorials you find online may use names
  that no longer exist.
- **(15m) Exercise: `04_eda-calls`.** Call rate over time, diel structure,
  gaps, detector artefacts. Ask for one plot at a time. Read every line before
  you run it.
- **(17m) Exercise: `05_covariates-erddap`.** Ask for code to pull SST and wind
  from ERDDAP — first cold, then with the package documentation pasted into the
  prompt. Compare. The cold attempt invents function signatures.

## Takeaway

Documentation in the prompt beats a bigger model. This is the single most
useful habit in the workshop.
